title: UDS AppShell
description: Machine-readable contract for AppShell layout: props, compound region tags, DOM roles, and AI agent rules. Normative runtime source: src/components/ui/app-shell.tsx and src/components/ui/app-shell.scss. Allowed package imports: see ai/uds-contract.json.

schemaKind.description: Identifies this document as the AppShell layout schema.

default: Header (internal — slot supplies trailing + search config)

props.description: AppShell root props (extends React.ComponentProps<'div'>). All slots are optional.

className.description: Merged onto root appshell div; prefer min-h-dvh w-full min-w-0 for full-viewport shells.

menu.description: Sidebar rail content — canonical: <Menu /> from the same package (nav-only inside AppShell). Branding + collapse toggle live in the full-width Header above the rail. AppShell CSS targets [data-slot=uds-menu-root]; do not use Sidebar* here without custom rail CSS.

sidebar.description: Deprecated alias of menu for older docs only.

brand.description: Brand id for Header wordmark and inherited Menu tokens when Menu omits brand.

headerVariant.description: Header identity: brand wordmark (default) or plain title text. See ai/guides/menu-header-identity.md.

headerTitle.description: Product/app name when headerVariant is title.

headerShortTitle.description: Legacy short title; unused for Header wordmark mode.

menuExpanded.description: Controlled menu expanded (desktop rail) / drawer open (below lg).

defaultMenuExpanded.description: Uncontrolled initial desktop menu expanded state. Below lg defaults to closed.

onMenuExpandedChange.description: Called when menu expand / drawer open state changes.

enableRouterOutlet.description: When true, renders React Router <Outlet /> inside .appshell--main before main children. Set false for static apps.

headerRight.description: ReactNode passed to the built-in Header as `trailing` (right actions). Not a replacement for the full <Header />; AppShell always renders Header with brand + toggle chrome.

headerSearchProps.description: Forwarded to Header's default SearchInput when search is shown (not hideSearch / headerLeading).

hideSearch.description: When true, omit the Header SearchInput. Also suppresses skip-to-search. Does not remove brand/toggle chrome.

headerLeading.description: Custom content that replaces the default SearchInput only (not brand/toggle). Same role as Header children for search. Implies search is not shown and skip-to-search is off.

listview.description: Secondary pane (master-detail, queues). Omit or pass null/undefined to collapse the listview column.

listviewWidth.description: Listview column width in px. Allowed band 320–480 (clamped). Default 320 (--appshell-listview-width). Widen toward 480 when row content needs more room (longer titles, Card entities).

footer.description: Document flow (not position fixed/absolute); 48px (--uds-spacing-48) margin-top; scrolls with page content. When MainContent is present, portals into that container (data-slot=main-content-footer); otherwise last child of appshell--main.

showSkipToContent.description: When true, renders a skip link that targets the main landmark (#uds-appshell-main by default).

skipToContentLabel.description: Visible/accessible label for the skip-to-content link.

showSkipToSearch.description: When true, renders a skip link that targets the Header search field (#uds-appshell-search by default) so keyboard users can bypass the menu rail.

skipToSearchLabel.description: Visible/accessible label for the skip-to-search link.

mainContentId.description: Id on the <main class=appshell--main> landmark; also used as the skip-to-content href hash.

searchContentId.description: Id applied to Header SearchInput (unless headerSearchProps.id is set); also used as the skip-to-search href hash.

children.description: Unmarked children render inside appshell--main after Router <Outlet />. Prefer <AppShell.Main> for clarity.

compoundRegions.description: Marker-only components (fragments); they do not render host elements. Prefer this API for explicit regions. Region children override the same-named prop when both are provided (region wins).

default.description: Supplies trailing actions for the standardized Header only (not a custom header element).
Listview pane inner content; column animates open when non-null.

default.mapsTo: props.children (when used as the exclusive main payload)
default.description: Primary page content after <Outlet />; use instead of loose children for clarity.
Footer region; portals into MainContent when present, otherwise last child of appshell--main.

outlet.default: React Router <Outlet /> is rendered inside .appshell--main inside Suspense; lazy route elements resolve there.

menuWidth.default: Desktop: body margin-left 280px or 56px via CSS :has([data-slot="uds-menu-root"][data-expanded]). AppShell owns expand state (menuExpanded) and syncs Menu. Below lg: body full width; menu is overlay drawer; scrim + Escape close.

listview.default: Open when listview slot is non-null. In-flow column (--appshell-listview-width); pane overflow:hidden. Only .appshell--main scrolls. List body scrolls inside [data-slot=appshell-listview-scroll] on the direct child column (header shrink-0). Shell height locks to 100dvh when open.

footer.default: Not position:fixed or absolute (position:static). When MainContent is mounted, AppShell.Footer portals into data-slot=main-content-footer (inside the active edge/fixed container). Otherwise last child of .appshell--main. margin-top: var(--uds-spacing-48). Nested [data-slot=uds-footer] has border-top suppressed in shell CSS.

header.default: Full-width .appshell--chrome above the menu (height --appshell-header-height): menu toggle + brand/title + search + trailing. Wordmark always visible (no collapsed mark). Below lg search collapses to icon. Menu rail starts under the Header.

default: Import AppShell only from @chghealthcare/unified-design-system (and styles from @chghealthcare/unified-design-system/styles.css). Never import from src/components/ui/* or dist/* in consumer code.
Use AppShell as the authenticated product shell default per ai/uds-contract.json layoutDefaults.

Canonical navigation: compose the menu slot with the package Menu component only (nav-only). Branding + menu toggle live in the AppShell Header. Sidebar* belongs in in-page layouts, not AppShell.menu, unless the team owns full rail positioning CSS.

Published props: menu, brand, headerVariant, headerTitle, menuExpanded, defaultMenuExpanded, listview, listviewWidth (320–480px, default 320), headerRight, headerLeading, headerSearchProps, hideSearch, footer, enableRouterOutlet, showSkipToContent, skipToContentLabel, showSkipToSearch, skipToSearchLabel, mainContentId, searchContentId, className. sidebar is a deprecated alias of menu.
AppShell.Header supplies only the trailing actions. Brand/toggle are shell chrome on AppShell props. hideSearch / headerLeading omit or replace search only. See ai/guides/menu-header-identity.md.

Accessibility: AppShell renders skip links (default on) for main (#uds-appshell-main tabindex=-1) and Header search (#uds-appshell-search inside role=search). Skip-to-search is omitted when hideSearch or headerLeading suppresses search. Do not nest another <main> inside AppShell.Main.

Place page UI in AppShell.Main. .appshell--main uses --uds-surface-secondary. AppShell.Main and MainContent have no built-in padding — recommend p-[length:var(--uds-spacing-24)] (24px) on MainContent or the page wrapper. When enableRouterOutlet is true (default), nested React Router child routes render in the bundled Outlet before main children; use one Router wrapping the layout route. Set enableRouterOutlet false for static pages.
Do not add CSS that sets .appshell--main > :first-child to max-height: 0 or otherwise hides the first main child to fix spacing.
Do not assume a consumer-only BrowserRouter feeds AppShell without nesting AppShell as a layout route under the same router.

Use listview prop for master-detail or queue patterns; omit to collapse the column (no showListview prop). Set listviewWidth between 320–480px based on content need (default 320; denser Item queues stay narrow; Card / longer meta may need up to 480). Structure listview as flex column: shrink-0 Toolbar titlebar (ToolbarTitle/Description for name/count) + optional SearchInput + [data-slot=appshell-listview-scroll] body of Item or Card entities. Do not use position:fixed on listview unless you own all offsets.

Footer is optional; when used, prefer package Footer — portals into MainContent when present (inside the active container), otherwise inline at the end of appshell--main; 48px space above; top border removed in shell footer region by design.

Debug: overlapping/duplicated page chrome → do not put <Outlet /> as AppShell children when enableRouterOutlet is true (use one outlet only); content at bottom → use AppShell.Main only, avoid flex-1 on page root; empty main → enableRouterOutlet false or add child routes; rail overlap → use Menu in menu slot. See ai/guides/appshell-navigation.md.
